Captured in a fresh 30-day Developer scratch org, deleted and deletion verified. A synthetic Customer Community profile had API Enabled. An assigned permission set granted Case Read, Create and Edit, but not Delete, and explicit Subject and Origin read/edit field access. The Status field grant was rejected. The same permission set granted access to the deployed Apex REST classes. Each row is the HTTP POST response from the authenticated Community user; each class's metadata declares the API version shown. Create and update ran in user mode and succeeded. Delete ran in user mode and threw System.TypeException. These observations are from Apex REST, not anonymous Apex or an interactive page.
A second fresh 30-day Developer scratch org used the same Community license, profile and grants for constructed-record and with-sharing controller controls at both APIs. The named classes in this fixture are the exact deployed sources for those rows. The org was deleted and deletion verified.
A third fresh 30-day Developer scratch org repeated the original REST route at both APIs with the exception message added to the response. The exact source is under project-message. The org was deleted and deletion verified.
